markdown_local_links.method_limit: Inline and reference-style Markdown paths only; Codex :line/:column suffixes are removed for file existence checks, not validated as positions. Fenced code, HTML links, and links outside this study are not inspected.

meter.late_recording_limit: No trusted receipt/call timestamps are present; lateness cannot be independently inferred from this meter.
meter.manual_activity_limit: Receipts cover cooperative wrapped operations only. Boundary-incident reports manual source-call uncertainty and a late groundwave reservation; neither can be certified or cleared by aggregate receipt consistency.

prose_classification_rule.current-scientific-prose: research/** chapter.md, source-ledger.md, synthesis.md; canonical active files only.
prose_classification_rule.evaluator: All evaluation/** Markdown, including interim synthesis, maps, criteria, and adjudication.
prose_classification_rule.historical-first-pass-or-correction: Research Markdown whose basename explicitly marks first-pass, initial, or correction material.
prose_classification_rule.other-study-markdown: Remaining Markdown; not presumed to be scientific prose.
prose_classification_rule.supplemental-continuation-prose: Research Markdown named chapter-continuation* or source-ledger-continuation*.

trackability.recommendation: Review untracked source/evidence for intended durable inclusion. Retain reproducibility-critical receipts and logs; classify scratch/tmp outputs, compiled binaries, and bytecode caches before staging or excluding them. This report deletes nothing.

word_count_note: Per-file whitespace-token counts only; no aggregate word total is reported because chapters, ledgers, synthesis, and historical/evaluator text overlap in purpose.
